answer.summary: The i18n checker step failed deterministically: it found 5 locale values identical to English (de Radial, de Version v{version}, es Radial, fr Relations, fr Version v{version}) and exited 1. The change adds or edits translation strings without translating them, so a rerun will fail the same way. Fix by translating the values or adding legitimate loanwords to scripts/i18n-loanwords.json.

evidence.quote: de.json — identical to the English value
Run "yarn auto-translation:all" to translate them. If a value is legitimately identical
(loanword, language name), add it to scripts/i18n-loanwords.json under the locale, e.g. "de": ["Dashboard"].
